description: EIA screening request by Sunlaws Development Company Limited for 'Erection of data centre comprising of three data centre buildings with associated infrastructure', Southside Data Centre, Land At Clawbare Cottage, Longformacus, Duns. decision_notes: APRS reports 'the development will need to have an EIA (decision letter 27 Feb 2026)'. Screening opinion text not obtained — SBC portal returned 503 during research; decision and date need direct verification.

description: Proposal of Application Notice for the Southside Data Centre. Scottish Borders Council confirmed that the proposed pre-application consultation — Longformacus Village Hall on 4 June 2026 and Westruther Village Hall on 10 June 2026 — satisfies the statutory requirement. PAN reference number not located (portal unreachable).
decision_notes: PAN accepted by the council (statutory 21-day check); around 170 residents attended the two June 2026 events.

events.title: Pre-application consultation, Westruther Village Hall (attended by the Duke of Roxburghe and Roxburghe Estates MD Jaap Röell)

description: Scoping Opinion request for erection of a data centre comprising three data centre buildings with associated infrastructure at Southside Data Centre, Land at Clawbare Cottage, Longformacus. The case establishes the scope of the Environmental Impact Assessment required before a planning application is submitted.
decision_notes: Scottish Borders Council's official portal records the case as Decided, with 'Screening/Scoping Opinion Issued'. The decision was both made and issued on 31 August 2026. The portal lists consultation material from SEPA, Scottish Water, NatureScot, Historic Environment Scotland and council services, but the documents themselves were unavailable for download during this refresh.
